name: prov_accountability
description: Accountability aspect of provenance: who did what, when, and with what: the person and their group, job, hosts, processes, commands, tools and versions.

history.why: The user asked for the four aspects of provenance (traceability, accountability, decision making, performance), each its own capability, and for one reading capability (prov_read: TraceViewer) used by every graph, query and check.
The configuration operation: each process's recorded settings (moirai's process metadata).
